name: Hollstein Cloud Detection (L2A / titiler variant)
description: Classifies clouds, cirrus, shadow, water, snow and clear sky from Sentinel-2 L2A reflectance using the Hollstein et al. (2016) decision tree. This titiler variant omits the cirrus band B10 (unavailable in L2A) and substitutes blue/SWIR proxies for the two B10-based tests. Converted from the Sentinel Hub Hollstein evalscript. Adapted from a SentinelHub Custom Script by André Hollstein.
